choices.title: Kuhl core desktop
choices.description: Official Fedora packages: Niri compositor, vertical Waybar, Rofi/Fuzzel launcher, Alacritty/Kitty, Mako, audio/network settings and Kuhl controls. GNOME is retained.

choices.title: Kuhl Sevens / Day / Dusk
choices.description: Three coordinated palettes. Default Sevens uses upstream MIT Niri/Waybar styling. Add your own wallpaper later.

choices.title: Replace existing desktop settings (with backups)
choices.description: For upgrades: backs up and replaces existing Niri, Waybar, Kitty, Rofi, Mako and Fuzzel configurations. Off by default; requires typing REPLACE first.

choices.title: Vicinae Spotlight-style search (optional COPR)
choices.description: Optional Spotlight-like launcher through a third-party COPR; review package source and give explicit consent. Otherwise Rofi/Fuzzel is configured.

choices.title: Network, Bluetooth and audio helpers
choices.description: NetworkManager tray applet, Blueman Bluetooth interface, brightnessctl and playerctl; basic network/audio settings are installed with the core desktop. Makes a standalone Niri session friendlier.
